versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated to clarify that OpenClaw config is now read via environment variables (e.g., DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), not just the JSON config file.
- No code changes in this release.

- Added github-issue.md for improved GitHub issue tracking and documentation.
- No changes to core functionality or analysis output.

- Added SKILL.md with detailed module descriptions, usage instructions, and highlights.
- Clarified 4-module English report structure and scoring criteria.
- Documented AI auto-detection via OpenClaw config with smart local fallback.
- Included CLI and OpenClaw usage examples for easy script analysis.
- Listed supported platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat) and Node.js runtime requirement.
- Added guidance for OpenClaw AI setup and fallback scenarios.
- Provided link to web version for advanced (12-dimension) analysis.
First release — English edition with AI + local fallback
